text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf called me over to watch her dance lesson—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —One, two, three, four!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...That's all. Is there anything
that catches your eye?
Symboli Rudolf's dancing was so utterly flawless that I couldn't immediately think of anything to say.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Judging by that reaction,
it seems it didn't turn out too badly."
choice_data_list: I'm sorry I couldn't say anything.
I'm sorry I couldn't say anything.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's fine. My minimum goal was just finishing it without any obvious flaws, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Let's continue honing this song.
There's still room for improvement."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then.
Next, I'd like to consult you about something new—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I wish to broaden my range of expression in dance.
What do you think I should incorporate right now?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I would truly appreciate your candid opinion.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm.
Cute choreography, is it—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Considering how people around me see me, that could certainly expand the "range" of my expression.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, let's put it into practice right away.
First, let's establish your definition of 'cute.'"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A smile, pigeon-toed stance, and a wink—
Heh, once again, I'm struck by how deep this truly goes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: However, I will definitely make it my own.

With those words, Symboli Rudolf boldly threw herself
into practicing the cute choreography.
"It seems this challenge helped broaden her range of expression."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Breakdancing, huh. Indeed, in terms of 'range,'
that is uncharted territory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Bodily dynamics unlike anything seen in dance before—
giving rise to an expression of unrestrained freedom and vibrant vitality.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If we can incorporate this,
it could lead to even further progress.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Alright. Now that we've decided, let's look into breakdancing right away.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You'll lend a hand too, right?

Thanks to this insatiable ambition, the breadth of her expression
expanded to yet another level.
